question: What is the antonym of "Laconic"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Wordy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Laconic"** means using very few words; concise or brief in speech or writing. (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** His laconic reply made it clear that he didn’t want to discuss the matter further.
 
 
• The word **"Wordy"** refers to someone or something that uses too many words; verbose or long-winded. (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** The essay was too wordy and could have been more concise.
 
 
• Since "Laconic" means concise, its antonym would be "Wordy," which means verbose or overly detailed.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Wordy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elliptical** (संक्षिप्त): Refers to speech or writing that is deliberately obscure or concise by omitting words.
 
 
• **Example:** His elliptical style of speaking often left others confused.
 
 

 
• **Compendious** (संक्षिप्त): Refers to something that is concise but comprehensive.
 
 
• **Example:** The book provides a compendious overview of world history.
 
 

 
• **Clipped** (कटे-छंटे): Refers to speech that is short, often abrupt in tone.
 
 
• **Example:** Her clipped responses indicated that she was annoyed.
